review_evidences.text: To increase data comparability, the following criteria were applied to select appropriate observations from the initial set of articles retrieved: (1) studies containing 15N uptake rates and/or the relative contribution of N forms to plant N nutrients by 15N labelling method were selected, and other methods (such as 15N natural abundance and concentration dilution) to explore plant N uptake strategies were excluded; (2) only the data from experiments with short isotopic exposure times were included to avoid transformations between 15NH4 , and studies that used the 15N tracer method to and 15NO3 explore long-term plant N retention, such as that of Templer et al. (2012), were excluded; (3) analyses restricted to species in natural plant communities in unfertilized soils were selected; (4) studies focusing on species-level N uptake but not on community-level N uptake were included; (5) as glycine (the smallest of amino acid, comprising 29% of the pool of amino-N) is a putative organic N source for plants, data using other organic N forms to represent organic N uptake were excluded from the database to make results comparable; and (6) for studies wherein uptake rates or the relative contribution of uptake rates were not directly available, we ﬁrst calculated the uptake rates by dividing the 15N uptake pools by the 15N labelling time and root biomass.
review_evidences.text_zh: 为了增加数据的可比性，我们采用以下标准从最初检索到的文章中选择合适的观察结果：(1)通过15N标记法选择含有15N吸收速率和/或N形态对植物N养分的相对贡献的研究，排除其他探索植物N吸收策略的方法（如15N自然丰度和浓度稀释）；(2)为了避免15NH4 之间的转化，只纳入了同位素暴露时间较短的实验数据，并排除了使用15N示踪法与15NO3探索植物长期N保留的研究，如Templer等（2012）；(3)选择未施肥土壤中天然植物群落的物种分析；(4)主要研究物种水平氮吸收而非群落水平氮吸收；(5)由于甘氨酸（最小的氨基酸，占氨基氮库的29%）是假定的植物有机氮来源，因此使用其他有机氮形式表示有机氮吸收的数据从数据库中排除，以使结果具有可比性；(6)对于无法直接获得吸收速率或吸收速率相对贡献的研究，我们首先通过将15N吸收库除以15N标记时间和根系生物量来计算吸收速率。
